# CineVault By Sasuu

> CineVault is a high-definition movie and television series catalog and discovery platform providing verified BitTorrent metadata, magnet links, trailers, IMDb ratings, subtitles, and detailed film specifications in 720p, 1080p, and 4K Ultra HD.

## Core Services & Capabilities

- **Curated Movie Catalog**: Search and browse thousands of feature films with IMDb ratings, genres, release years, directors, cast members, and high-resolution artwork.
- **TV Series & Episode Index**: Integrated television torrent index powered by the EZTV API and TVmaze for multi-season releases and verified episode downloads.
- **BitTorrent & Magnet Direct Delivery**: Direct magnet URI launchers (`magnet:?xt=urn:btih:...`) compatible with BitTorrent clients such as qBittorrent, Transmission, and Deluge.
- **Offline Download Packages**: One-click download bundles (.zip) with torrent metadata, high-resolution movie artwork, desktop internet shortcuts, and branded HTML companion documentation.
- **Synchronized Subtitles**: Integrated multi-language SRT/VTT subtitle downloads.
- **CineBot AI Concierge**: Built-in cinematic discovery assistant for contextual film and show recommendations.

## Canonical URLs & Structure

- Official Website: https://www.moviesandseries.xyz
- Movie Detail Route: `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/movies/{movie-slug}` (e.g., `/movies/inception-2010`)
- TV Series Route: `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/series/{imdb-id}-{series-slug}` (e.g., `/series/tt0903747-breaking-bad`)
- Sitemaps: https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/sitemap.xml
- Full LLM Specification: https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/llms-full.txt
- Privacy Policy: https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/privacy-policy

## Key Sections & Endpoints

- [Browse Movies](https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/): Explore trending, top-rated, 4K UHD, and newly released films.
- [TV Series Index](https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/series): Search full television seasons and individual episode torrents.
